review_improvement: Preserves the exact XGMI CPER coverage while adding two-ended link identity, collision-safe attribution, artifact integrity and full-fabric recovery instead of accepting an index delta.
independent_technical_reasoning: An XGMI link joins two GPU endpoints, so a link1 DataLossErr must identify both the enumerated route and decoded OAM/AID; numbering alone is not stable proof. The BMC can log unrelated records concurrently, making +1 supportive but not sufficient without timestamps and metadata. Ext0/DataLossErr, XGMI bank and fatal severity must coexist in the same integrity-checked CPER. Because interconnect failure can partition peers, all links and GPUs must recover before any repeat.
